author: Oilerator
body: Hi, I am here today to ask if I could be un-banned from this server. I was banned for fly hacks, and I am deeply sorry for hacking on your servers. I will not do it again and I am hoping to be unbanned, so if I get bored of OCN I can come here. Please un-ban me as I will never hack again on Avicus network.

replies.author: Iron
replies.body:
Hello,

No evidence is present for your ban, hence I am appealing you! Welcome back to Avicus.

Thanks,
Iron Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
